decisions.reason: Assigning the Nolan Pierce article to the People category does not change the existing author-name, author-photo, identity-matching, source, or placement requirements.
The category assignment does not affect image requests or the elements used to break up excessive article text.
The source changes only the article's category mapping and does not alter author-photo shape or size.
The Nolan Pierce category mapping does not affect the separate color restriction for the Dorian Vale article or the cover.
Identifying Article 6 as People does not change the requirement to source article content from the Civic Lantern website.
The article-specific category assignment does not modify the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The category mapping does not change the interactive digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The source contains no change to image-quality enhancement or use of AI for imagery.
The Article 6 category assignment neither changes the deferred print-ready deliverable nor resumes it.
